title: Give OLY-B-O1-01 a mechanism: bootstrap-range gate, spec entry and test
summary: Point OLY-B-O1-01 in docs/spec.toml at the existing history-invariant bootstrap range (`athena_gate::invariant::bootstrap_range`, rule M6), which accepts `Athena-Job: bootstrap` commits only until records/jobs/bootstrap/outcome.json closes the range. Add a test that checks the spec entry and exercises that gate, with a `status: not shown` measure naming the test.

defaults_applied.how: New test plus fmt, clippy and test criteria.
Criteria run the gate test and check the spec entry text.
Requirement points at an enforced gate; the unenforced 'stays small' part is marked not shown.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal and audience: the spec gap list (shown by `athena status`) and the verifier, who need OLY-B-O1-01 to name a real mechanism, an owner and a measure.

Code survey: read crates/athena-gate/src/invariant.rs (BOOTSTRAP_OUTCOME, bootstrap_range, rule M6, test bootstrap_commits_pass_while_the_range_is_open_and_not_after), crates/athena-data/src/id.rs (JobId::Bootstrap reserved, dir records/jobs/bootstrap), crates/athena-core/src/status.rs (STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS, no 'bootstrap' label) and crates/athena-core/tests/model_roster.rs (precedent: spec_entry_has_a_real_mechanism).

No record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file, AnyRecord and the round-trip test are not affected. No refusal rule is added or tightened; the gate already exists, so no refusal-rate criterion applies.
Mechanism is the existing bootstrap-range gate; 'v0 stays small' is not mechanically enforced and the measure says 'status: not shown' and names the test; this is stated in the measure.

Existing code: crates/athena-gate/src/invariant.rs, crates/athena-data/src/id.rs, docs/records.md (Closing the bootstrap), docs/design/requirements-map.md (OM-3); the new test reuses model_roster.rs's spec-entry parsing approach.
Consumers: none found for docs/spec.toml other than xtask spec tests and status.rs measure labels; no governance file (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) changes.

acceptance_criteria.text: In docs/spec.toml the OLY-B-O1-01 entry no longer has mechanism = "none"; it names athena_gate::invariant::bootstrap_range (rule M6), keeps owner = "Athena", and its measure ends with `status: not shown` and names the test that shows it.

A new test file under crates/athena-gate/tests/ reads docs/spec.toml, fails if the OLY-B-O1-01 entry has mechanism "none", lacks the mechanism name, owner or the `status: not shown` ending; run `cargo test -p athena-gate`. It fails on the base tree and passes with the change.

The same test (or the existing invariant test) shows the gate accepts an `Athena-Job: bootstrap` commit while the range is open and refuses one after records/jobs/bootstrap/outcome.json closes it; run `cargo test -p athena-gate bootstrap`.
`cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test` all pass from the repository root, including the xtask spec test that checks measure markers.
CHANGELOG.md gets an entry if the repository convention requires one for spec changes; no other path (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows, records/) changes.

out_of_scope: Changing the gate's behavior or the bootstrap range rules
Enforcing 'v0 stays small' by a size limit
departures: Small spec-plus-test change on an existing mechanism, so slightly cheaper and faster than the reference.
